feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: NPR coverage of national news, U.S. politics, elections, business, arts, culture, health and science, and technology. Subscribe to the NPR Nation RSS feed.

entry.title: Judge considers restoring journalists' access to White House after Trump's ban
entry.summary: Lawyers representing the White House and the three media outlets banned from the property sparred over the constitutional rights of journalists at a hearing in federal court Wednesday.

entry.title: FBI records point to possible congressional pay-for-play scheme
entry.summary: NPR's Juana Summers talks with Avi Asher-Schapiro of ProPublica about the connections between a defense contractor and Sen. Susan Collins of Maine, and how the FBI was, at one time, looking into it.

entry.title: From cybersecurity to AI to Taiwan, what's at stake in Trump's summit with Xi
entry.summary: As President Trump and China's President Xi prepare to meet, Rush Doshi of the Council on Foreign Relations explains the current state of U.S.-China relations and what to expect from this summit.

entry.title: It's getting harder to afford rent in the U.S., even for middle-income families
entry.summary: Housing affordability challenges are spreading to higher income brackets, according to new research, which found one in five renters struggled last year to pay for their housing in full and on time.

entry.title: U.N. Ambassador Mike Waltz on Iran, Venezuela and Trump's foreign policy
entry.summary: Deals, threats and oil are all on the table as the president's foreign policy takes center stage.

entry.title: DOJ defends White House media ban, urges court to reject lawsuit
entry.summary: The Department of Justice defended President Trump's recent media ban, arguing that reporting by CNN, MS Now and Politico on a wide range of issues jeopardized national security and spread falsehoods.

entry.title: Major news outlets banned by Trump will have their day in court
entry.summary: CNN, MS NOW, and Politico are asking a federal judge to hold the president in check for what they say is a violation of their Constitutional rights simply because he doesn't like how they cover him.

entry.title: There's growing concern that Trump may deploy the National Guard ahead of elections
entry.summary: Fears are growing that President Trump may deploy the U.S. military to polling places in the upcoming elections, despite strict state and federal laws against such a move.

entry.title: ICE is looking into 'mobile detention facilities'
entry.summary: Buried in the paperwork for Immigration and Customs Enforcement's expansion in Pennsylvania is a document requesting "mobile detention facilities."

entry.title: Trump is on voters' minds in the midterms -- and they're not happy, poll shows
entry.summary: A new NPR/PBS News/Marist poll finds President Trump — and his unpopularity — is an outsize factor in why most voters say they want Democrats to win the midterms.
